The repository update then writes a null photo, which clears the avatar. An omitted field should mean 'leave unchanged', so `photo` should stay undefined. Only an explicit `null` should clear the photo.

fix.description: Change the branch to `else if (updateUserDto.photo === null) { photo = null; }`. An omitted photo then stays undefined and is not overwritten, and only an explicit null clears it.

candidates.explanation: When the update DTO omits `photo` (for example, when only the first name is edited), `updateUserDto.photo === undefined` is true, so `photo` is set to `null`. The repository update then writes a null photo, which clears the avatar. An omitted field should mean 'leave unchanged', so `photo` should stay undefined. Only an explicit `null` should clear the photo.

fix.description: Change the branch to `else if (updateUserDto.photo === null) { photo = null; }`. An omitted photo then stays undefined and is not overwritten, and only an explicit null clears it.
